positions.name: QuantumMigrationBenefitCase
positions.frame: what performance-and-cost case is being made for the QuantumDB switch, and does it hold across both the verbal claim and the written summary?
positions.why: Both expressions restate the same '10x' performance multiplier and cost framing — src-2 as a flat spoken assertion, src-3 as the structured written summary re-presenting the identical figure. The directional reads converge: market-pricing/rational-persuasion relational framing, self-enhancement/competence value appeal, and activated-positive affect all recur across both, and both sit in the 'claim'/'informational' register rather than performing the decision itself. That is a genuine repeated benefit-case, not an incidental echo — src-3 restates src-2's justification in shorthand form rather than adding new content.
